description: A multi-sheet workbook on a Svelte 5 spreadsheet grid with one formula engine spanning the sheets: Prices is a lookup table, Orders VLOOKUPs into it and Summary SUMs over Orders, so editing a unit price travels two sheets and recomputes only what depended on it. Sheet tabs switch, rename and reorder; Ctrl+PageUp and Ctrl+PageDown move between sheets and Shift+F11 inserts one, from anywhere in the grid. Enterprise, in @svgrid/enterprise.

faq.question: How do formulas reach another sheet?
faq.answer: With the Sheet!A1 form, Prices!B2 or Prices!A2:B20 in a VLOOKUP. The workbook keeps one dependency graph across every sheet, so a change on Prices recalculates the cells on Orders and Summary that read it.

faq.question: Can sheets be renamed?
faq.answer: Yes, double-click a tab or use its menu. References in formulas follow the rename, so =SUM(Orders!D2:D9) keeps working after Orders becomes Sales.

faq.question: Which keys move between sheets?
faq.answer: Ctrl+PageUp and Ctrl+PageDown switch to the previous and next sheet, and Shift+F11 inserts a new one, all while the focus stays in the grid.
